# Student Assistant - Healthcare

## Use your medical knowledge to shape safer healthcare AI - quality-check Danish clinical language and help improve tools used by GPs, alongside your medical studies.

Apply

**Shape the medical language behind the AI that Danish GPs use every day.***Are you a medical student who is curious about how AI is changing the way doctors work? Do you want to use your clinical knowledge to make sure the AI tools used in Danish primary care get the medicine right?*

*Then you might be our new student colleague in Healthcare AI!*

**As part of the department**  
We welcome medical students to join our Healthcare AI team in a part-time position (Up till 19 hours a week on the students' jobs) alongside your studies, based in Denmark. You will work closely with the international product and development team behind EG AI for healthcare, a suite of AI products used widely by general practitioners and specialists in Norway and Denmark. The products support clinical documentation and actions, such as journal notes, referral letters and certificates, and are powered by AI agents for the healthcare sector. Our focus is to make sure that the content EG AI generates is medically correct, complete and recognizable, and that it provides real value.   
The position can be based either in our Aarhus office or in the Copenhagen/Ballerup area.

**Your Tasks: Curating Medical Language & Quality-Checking AI**

* Expand and quality-check medical vocabularies and terminology in Danish, for general practice and selected specialties.
* Produce and quality-check validation datasets (“golden cases”) for the use cases EG AI for healthcare targets.
* Contribute to specialty-specific adaptations of EG's AI agents for healthcare, together with the product team.
* Help ensure that AI-generated content is medically correct, clinically acceptable, and complete.

**You are the ideal candidate if you**

* Are a medical student (stud. Med.), at least in your 4th year.
* Are fluent in Danish, written and spoken.
* Work precisely and in a structured way.
* Have strong written communication skills.
* Enjoy working both independently and in a team.
* Have interest in health technology and/or artificial intelligence is an advantage.
* Can commit roughly 20% of your time on an hourly basis, alongside your studies.
* Are based in Denmark.

**What's in it for you?**

* A flexible part-time role of up to 19 hours per week that fits around your studies.
* A temporary, hourly-based position with a flexible schedule.
* Insight into how AI products for the healthcare sector are developed and quality assured.
* Close collaboration with the product and development team behind EG AI for healthcare.
* The chance to directly influence the quality of AI tools used by clinicians today.
* The chance to take part in the further development of AI tools for the Danish healthcare system.

**Our Values**

* Lead the Industry - We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
* Make it Happen - We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
* Stronger Together - We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.

**We look forward to hearing from you!**If you would like more information before you apply, please feel free to contact Product Manager **Johannes Straume** on [**jstra@eg.no**](mailto:jstra@eg.no). We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**  
Our industry-specific software help people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.

Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security.

If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here. You'll be trusted to grow your skills, shape meaningful solutions, and make an impact together with talented colleagues across borders.

Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.
